node.title: LEAP: below-cap spread exceptions are exactly the finite-geometry class
node.statement: RESTATED per E13 (second revision, both pre-registered): below-cap spread rank loss is (i) finite-geometry/net shaped (AG census: 373 nondegenerate exceptions, 0 unclassified), (ii) v-syndrome degenerate, or (iii) a full-support sparse-greedy syzygy circuit (all 71 n=32 controls; proved circuit lemma). Three observed branches, each precise; the conjecture is that the list is now complete.
node.attack_surface: rung 1 is a computation (extend E3's search to all configurations at n = 16..32); rung 2 uses the cap theorem's span structure; the AG witnesses' rank pattern (11/12, one deficit) suggests a one-relation characterization
node.falsifier: an exception at small scale embedding in NO finite-geometry configuration, or a growing-deficit family
node.notes: CALCULATED LEAP grounded in E3 (PR #185): witness shape + proved cap + saturation-degeneracy. Replaces the refuted naive form with a classified-exception form. | E13: finite-geometry-only was too narrow — the syzygy branch is the fix, with its lemma already proved in #185.
